text:
Sara (Marketing): Heads up — we're announcing the Adaptive Batching release next Wed. Need final changelog link, docs quickstart URL, benchmark blurb, webinar slot, and a canary window. Can engineering confirm rollout timing? :calendar:

Noah (Engineering): Confirming. Can we do canary Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC, ramp to full by 13:00 if no errors? Any constraints on model swaps? (cc @Eleni)

Maria (Product): Works for PM. Webinar slot locked 03/27 15:00 PT. We want a 15-min demo + 15-min Q&A.

Eleni (Docs): Docs draft is at https://docs.google.com/xyz — waiting on final API call examples and changelog bullets from eng.

Noah (Engineering): Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — PR description has bullets. I'll add a one-line 'what's new' for marketing by EOD.

Sara (Marketing): Perfect. Can you drop a 2-sentence benchmark blurb — latency and cost percent — so we can publish with the post? e.g., '30% lower p50 latency, 20% token-cost reduction vs baseline.'

Tom (DSE): Bench blurb: p50 down ~28% on small prompt distro; quantized endpoints reduce token CPU by ~18%. Caveat: numbers are median across our benchmarks. I'll paste table in a sec.

Tom (DSE): ```Benchmark snapshot (internal)
model: rwd-adapt-v1
prompt-dist: small (<=128)
p50: 42ms -> 30ms (-28%)
token-cost: 1.00 -> 0.82 (-18%)
```

Noah (Engineering): PR updated with 'marketing blurb' section. Also adding canary toggle flag name: `feature.adaptive_batching` — QA to flip.

QA_Bot: Canary scheduled by ops for 1765249000 (Wed 09:00 UTC). Alert if error-rate > 0.5% over 5m.

Priya (Support): We'll prep inbound routing playbook. Need the canonical docs link and the sample support FAQ.

Sara (Marketing): Timeline we need: final blurb + docs by EOD Tue (1765334799), assets (screenshots, GIF) by Wed 04:00 UTC, announce at 13:30 UTC. Can we commit?

Noah (Engineering): Committed — blurb done, docs link soon, GIF from perf team by Tue night.

Eleni (Docs): Added API code examples and quickstart. Public link: https://docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-batching — ready for review.

Sara (Marketing): Awesome. I'll draft the launch post and paste into #marketing-drafts. @Noah please sanity-check the 'how it works' paragraph.

Noah (Engineering): Will do. Quick note: rollout has fallback to previous model via routing policy 'fallback:stable' — mention that we have graceful degradation.

Maria (Product): Also add customer-facing note about expected behavior during canary (possible short 1-2 token higher latency spikes).

Sara (Marketing): Thanks all. If no objections by EOD I'll schedule the announce and webinar invite. :rocket:
